title: Conditional Flow Matching for Time Series Modelling
method_summary: 以 BB-Flows 的线性高斯边际插值或 GP-Flows 的状态/导数联合高斯后验形成轨迹条件速度目标。

design_choices: Standard diagonal zero-drift Kalman/RTS repairs printed smoothing gain/covariance equations; m0=y0,P0=1 are explicit initialization choices.
BB paper_literal implements printed Eq.8; gaussian_consistent instead uses 0.5*Pprime/P(t)*(x-m(t)), the velocity of Eq.7 Gaussian interpolation. Kept as distinct configurations.
GP paper_literal omits posterior means as printed Eq.10; gaussian_conditional restores derivative mean and centered state, the standard Gaussian conditional derivative.
GP MLE uses L-BFGS-B rather than unspecified author optimizer, shared RBF across independent state dimensions; dense covariance sampled jointly over queries.

TimeMLP differs from ambiguous 64/258-dimension architecture; RK4 replaces dopri5 during diagnostic simulation; main/appendix trajectory counts and batch size conflicts must be frozen before comparisons.
configuration.evaluation: frozen grouped train/validation/test protocol required; no test-label threshold tuning; no synthetic benchmark claim
